lyrics.text: 当最后一道界限崩裂，深渊绽放极星神乐
lyrics.sub_text: When the final threshold shatters, zenith kagura blooms

lyrics.text: 镜花万象尽归于零，重构超越凡俗的律动
lyrics.sub_text: Mirrored illusions collapse to zero, forging transcendent rhythm

lyrics.text: 以双域共鸣之剑，斩开通往十五极境的王座
lyrics.sub_text: Wield the twin-zone blade to cleave the throne of Level 15

lyrics.text: 破碎之后方见真章，此刻加冕樱华绝巅
lyrics.sub_text: Truth emerges past shatter—be crowned atop Sakura's apex
